deploy-bot: Deploy started: prod · staggered fanout · services=[runtime:release-3.3.0 (sha:abc1234), api:release-2.9.0 (sha:def5678), console:release-1.6.0 (sha:ghi9012)] · canary plan: runtime 5% -> 20% -> 100% · window: 2026-03-20T14:00Z
aline: watching infra metrics (p99/cpu/heap) :eyes:
maria: noticing higher p95 for runtime pods already :thinking_face:
ryan: starting canary at 5% now
deploy-bot: runtime canary 5% -> success
maria: API 502 spike coincident with runtime canary, traces show increased latency on runtime->api (gRPC)
tom: @maria can you paste a sample trace id?
maria: trace id trace-0a1b2c3d — latency jump at runtime.kv.get and retry storms
aline: could be cache cold start + burst of requests, recommend hold next step
ryan: pausing further runtime fanout (manual hold enacted)
deploy-bot: runtime canary held at 5% pending manual approval
janet: product: any user-facing errors? are we seeing customer impact?
maria: some 502s in prod-1 region, limited but visible in alerts. suggest pinning runtime to last-stable until RCA
ryan: propose pin runtime -> release-3.2.1 (sha:bbb2222) to stop the spike while we investigate
aline: agree — pin runtime, allow api/console to continue if healthy
maria: preparing rollback patch now
ryan: rollback commands I'll run:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:release-3.2.1 --record
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/runtime -w
```
deploy-bot: api canary 5% -> success
deploy-bot: console rollout completed
tom: I'll watch global error budget and circuit breakers for 30m post-patch
janet: publishing short customer-facing note and internal release tracker: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-20/prod-window
maria: rollback to 3.2.1 initiated (patch INF-4321 created)
deploy-bot: runtime rollout to release-3.2.1 started (sha:bbb2222) — target pods 12
aline: warming KV caches on canary nodes per warmup plan
maria: metrics trending back to baseline, 502s falling :thumbsup:
ryan: suggest hold fanout for 20m after stable to confirm no regression, then unhold
tom: +1 on 20m, also tighten grpc timeouts for api to reduce blast radius
janet: product will send status update to affected customers after 30m if stable
deploy-bot: thread update: fanout paused, runtime pinned to release-3.2.1, api/console live. Follow-ups: INF-4321 for RCA and postmortem. Oncall: @tom monitoring.
